source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the parathyroid glands (PDF 64).

blocks.text: Yeh chaar chhote glands hain jo thyroid gland ki pichli sateh (posterior surface) se jure hote hain. Parathyroid glands parathormone hormone chhorte hain. Jab khoon mein calcium kam ho jaye to parathormone chhoot'ta hai. Yeh osteoclasts (haddi ke cells) ko uksata hai ke woh bone matrix (haddi ke maadde) ke calcium crystals ghola kar calcium khoon mein chhorein. Yeh gurdon ko peshab se calcium wapas jazb (reabsorb) karne par bhi uksata hai. Yeh vitamin D ko bhi active karta hai, jo aant mein khurak se calcium jazb karne ke liye zaroori hai.

Parathormone zyada nikle (jo parathyroid gland ki rasoli, yani tumour, se ho sakta hai) to haddiyon se bohat zyada calcium nikal jata hai; haddiyan naram ho kar tedhi (deform) ho jati hain. Khoon mein calcium barh jata hai (hypercalcemia), jo nervous system ko susti mein daal deta hai aur muscles ko kamzor karta hai. Parathormone kam nikle to hypocalcaemia (khoon mein calcium ki kami) hota hai. Is se neurons zyada excitable (jaldi bharakne wale) ho jate hain, aur tetany ho sakti hai jis mein muscles sukri (contracted) halat mein reh jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Parathormone aur calcitonin ke asraat ulte (opposite) kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Parathormone khoon ka calcium barhata hai: haddi se calcium nikalwata hai, gurdon se calcium wapas jazb karwata hai aur vitamin D ko active kar ke aant se calcium jazb karwata hai. Calcitonin calcium ko haddiyon mein jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium kam karta hai.

items: Chaar parathyroid glands thyroid ki pichli sateh par; hormone: parathormone.
Khoon ka calcium girne par parathormone: haddi se calcium (osteoclasts), gurdon se wapas jazb, vitamin D active.
Zyada: naram aur tedhi haddiyan, hypercalcemia; kam: hypocalcaemia, tetany.
